__task_type_notes__: estimation_or_reconstruction: RGB is used as the condition to generate a non-RGB modality; this covers reconstruction-style tasks such as RGB-to-3D/spatial information.
conditional_control: a non-RGB modality is used as the condition to generate RGB or another non-RGB modality.
conditional_control+narrow_generation: caption and a non-RGB modality are used together to generate RGB; this is both conditional control and caption-driven narrow generation.

general_generation: caption alone is used as the condition to generate any modality; currently not planned for training because RGB can be generated first and other modalities can then be reconstructed/estimated.
narrow_generation: caption alone is used as the condition to generate RGB; base text-to-image/text-to-video models belong to this category.
inverse_rendering: RGB plus another modality are used together as conditions to generate a non-RGB modality.
sparse adapter note: adapter_task selects the concrete sparse training path used by scripts/launch_scripts/train_sparse_structure_models.sh.
sparse adapter note: condition_preprocess records derived features such as PARE crops, full RGB tensors, or normalized object point clouds.
sparse adapter note: validated default Heads store their deployment choice directly in recommended_checkpoint; optional experimental Heads omit that key.
audio reconstruction note: cropped visual source cues can be used as estimation_or_reconstruction conditions for waveform/audio targets such as 175-184.

audio sparse note: 175-184 is the real scene/source audio; audio localization uses [175-184, 0-2] as audio+full-RGB conditions to predict a source box, audio segmentation uses the same conditions to predict the source mask, while audio classification uses 175-184 alone. 185-194 caption/TTS audio is kept out of the default sparse training set.

Channel_Head_000000.condition_description: 0-2: RGB crop encoded as PARE features
Channel_Head_000000.target_description: 72-87 and 90-93: SMPL/SMPLer-X body pose, shape, and related sparse human-structure parameters used by the ScoreHMR adapter

Channel_Head_000001.condition_description: 0-2: full RGB image resized for bbox prediction
Channel_Head_000001.target_description: 88-89: multi-person bounding boxes represented by the bbox adapter; boxes are derived from MediaPipe person/id visibility channels when building the dataset

dense_to_sparse_variants.encoding: black-background filled instance rectangles with a fixed left-to-right pseudocolor palette, encoded by the FLUX.2 VAE
dense_to_sparse_variants.decode: prototype-color segmentation followed by one bounding rectangle per recovered instance region

Channel_Head_000002.condition_description: 0-2: RGB crop encoded as PARE features
Channel_Head_000002.target_description: 64: DWPose person id | 65: DWPose keypoint id | 66: DWPose confidence/score

Channel_Head_000003.condition_description: 0-2: RGB crop encoded as PARE features
Channel_Head_000003.target_description: 95: MediaPipe person id | 96: MediaPipe joint id | 97: relative z depth | 98: visibility confidence

Channel_Head_000004.condition_description: 111/112/114-116: object id, class value, and vertex xyz fields converted into a normalized object/group point cloud
Channel_Head_000004.target_description: 112-121: sparse object/animal structure payload; current adapter trains a BFS skeleton tree from class=3 joints and class=4 bones

Channel_Head_000005.condition_description: 175-184: real scene/source video audio | 0-2: full RGB image used as the visual grounding condition
Channel_Head_000005.target_description: 195-derived sound-source box supervision from pipeline29/audio mask; used for audio-source localization

Channel_Head_000006.condition_description: 175-184: real scene/source video audio used as the only condition
Channel_Head_000006.target_description: 195: AVIS semantic category id supervision from pipeline29; used for audio category recognition/classification

Channel_Head_000007.condition_description: 0-2: cropped RGB/source image used as the visual condition for real scene/source audio generation
Channel_Head_000007.target_description: 175-184: real scene/source video audio generated or reconstructed in waveform/audio feature space

Channel_Head_000008.condition_description: 175-184: frame-level AST audio feature condition | CurrentFrame_RGB_Condition: current RGB latent used as a trainable spatial condition lane
Channel_Head_000008.target_description: 195: dense semantic/source mask latent predicted from frame-level audio condition and current RGB condition; used for audio-source segmentation/inverse rendering

Channel_Head_000009.condition_description: CurrentFrame_RGB_Condition: current RGB latent used as the primary spatial estimation condition | 175-184: frame-level AST audio feature injected as one global auxiliary condition token
Channel_Head_000009.target_description: 195: dense semantic/source mask estimated directly from the current RGB frame with current-frame audio as auxiliary evidence; trained with the target-195 prototype CE recipe

Channel_Head_000010.condition_description: 0-2: RGB drives candidate channel-195 mask geometry | 175-184: frame audio drives the default categorical Head, which selects zero, one, or multiple sounding candidate regions and assigns their semantic colors
Channel_Head_000010.target_description: 195: audio-selected semantic source mask; RGB generates candidate regions and the default audio-conditioned categorical Head performs multi-region selection and exact category coloring
